name: Snowflake MCP
tagline: Query your Snowflake data warehouse from your AI agent.
shortDescription: The official Snowflake MCP server. Run SQL queries against Snowflake, list databases and schemas, inspect tables, and manage warehouses. The canonical way to give an agent access to your data warehouse.
longDescription:
## What it is

The Snowflake MCP server, contributed by Snowflake. Exposes the Snowflake SQL API as MCP tools: run queries, list databases/schemas/tables, inspect table DDL, manage warehouses, and load data from stages.

## Why we recommend it

If your company uses Snowflake as the data warehouse, this is the cleanest way to give an agent the ability to answer business questions in chat. The auth uses the same Snowflake credentials you already have, and you can scope to read-only via Snowflake's role-based access control.

## When to use it

- Business analytics: agent answers ad-hoc questions about revenue, churn, funnels
- Data engineering: agent inspects schemas, suggests optimizations, generates dbt models
- Reporting: agent pulls data for a one-off report or dashboard
- Compliance audits: agent lists who has access to what
installInstructions:
1. Create a Snowflake user with read-only role
2. Set: `SNOWFLAKE_ACCOUNT`, `SNOWFLAKE_USER`, `SNOWFLAKE_PASSWORD`, `SNOWFLAKE_DATABASE`, `SNOWFLAKE_SCHEMA`, `SNOWFLAKE_WAREHOUSE`
3. For SSO/SAML: use external browser auth
4. `uvx snowflake-mcp`

**Security note:** Use a read-only role for safe exploration. Snowflake's query history will show all agent activity.
pricingDetails: Free. The MCP server is open source. Snowflake charges per-warehouse compute (not per query); pricing varies.
